repowise.instructions: Primary code-navigation surface for ALL SoleMD projects — one workspace server with a repo= argument (repos: infra [default], graph, make, web; repo="all" fans out federated search; list_repos is discovery). On every search row target_path is the FILE; the symbol is symbol_path (source-lane rows, nested chain like Outer::inner) or symbol_id (wiki-lane symbol rows, v0.46.0) — never feed target_path alone to get_symbol. Orientation tools: get_overview (architecture map, once per unfamiliar repo), get_architecture (workspace layers/communities), get_index_status (is the index current — read its trust verdict and working_tree block; mode="path" for one file), get_health (defect/maintainability/performance scores for touched files), get_dead_code (confidence-tiered unreachable code for cleanup sweeps), get_query_quality (how the search lane treated a query). get_dependency_path answers call-path questions; get_dependents gives complete inbound totals (honest pagination, never a sample presented as a total). Before a risky edit, pair get_change_risk (defect score for a commit or base..head range) with get_blast_radius (workspace-wide impact); get_risk PR-mode leads with a directive — read may_break / missing_cochanges / tests_to_run first (tests_to_run_basis=measured means proven linkage; inferred is naming-only). get_reference_sites takes target=SYMBOL NAME (not a path); preview_symbol_rename previews a rename's site list. Flows via get_execution_flows; task slices via build_task_slice/get_task_slice/extend_task_slice when one work-package beats serial probes; find_clones/find_patterns for prior art before writing new code. get_why + manage_decision read each repo's git-tracked decision journal (<repo>/.codeatlas/decisions.jsonl, chosen by repo=, default infra); journal_exists:false on a list/get means that repo has no journal file yet, not zero decisions. Agents propose with manage_decision(action="record", repo=…) — it lands proposed and creates a missing journal (journal_created:true); Jon ratifies with confirm or by committing the diff. repo="all" lists across repos and searches get_why; every write names one repo. Workspace-wide rules (the Neo4j drop, the sidecar rule, the vibe dispatcher) live in infra's journal. Wire shape (unit 4.2): structuredContent IS the flat tool payload (no {result: …} wrapper) and the trust envelope — contract_version, timing_ms, embedder_degraded, retrieval_degraded, source_search, repo_freshness, index_behind — arrives as the JSON-RPC result's protocol _meta, never inside the payload; the text block mirrors the flat payload. Caution + a right-looking owner is NORMAL for verbose natural-language queries (coverage dilution) — tighten to the distinctive identifiers rather than distrusting the owner.
